rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: This reports the external APIs that are used with untrusted data, along with how frequently the API is called, and how many unique sources of untrusted data flow to it.

rules.cwe_name: Use of GET Request Method With Sensitive Query Strings
rules.description: Placing sensitive data in a GET request increases the risk of the data being exposed to an attacker.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: Comparing the result of a typeof test against a string other than 'undefined', 'boolean', 'number', 'string', 'object', 'function' or 'symbol' is useless, since this comparison can never succeed.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: Using too many or too few arguments in a call to a function will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: Use of a non-constant-time verification routine to check the value of an secret, possibly allowing a timing attack to retrieve sensitive information.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
rules.description: Using a named argument whose name does not correspond to a parameter of the called function or method, will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
rules.description: Some mathematical operations on random numbers can cause bias in the results and compromise security.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
rules.description: Calling a method with a user-controlled name may dispatch to an unexpected target, which could cause an exception.

rules.cwe_name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
rules.description: A regular expression that requires exponential time to match certain inputs can be a performance bottleneck, and may be vulnerable to denial-of-service attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs
rules.description: Checking for the "javascript:" URL scheme without also checking for "vbscript:" and "data:" suggests a logic error or even a security vulnerability.
